Subject: Dedicated capacity — pre-demo technical notes

Hi Sophie — appreciate the numbers, that helps a lot. A few quick notes we’ll cover in the demo and items to prep if you’d like deeper benchmarking: 

- With a 33B model quantized to int8, 200–250 RPS sustained is achievable on a 16-GPU Dedicated pool with batching and KV-prefix caching; p99 will depend on batching window but we often see p99 in the 80–150ms range for decode-only flows in similar setups.
- Bursts to ~300 RPS are handled via short-term burst capacity (configurable); we’ll show the autoscaling profile and how fallback to hosted variants works.
- For sequence lengths ~450–500 tokens, kernel selection and kv-cache behavior matters — bring an anonymized sample trace if you can.

Attachments: MVP_Dedicated_Specs.pdf (capacity sizing cheat sheet)

Proposed confirmed slot: Thu Jul 3, 15:00–15:40 EDT — I’ll present the infra sizing and Diego will do a quick demo of live request flow. Can you confirm attendees (names & roles)? Also, does Acme require an NDA before a technical deep dive?
